pattern: にしたところで / としたところで
aliases: ni shita tokoro de / to shita tokoro de
purpose: Apply a limit or difficulty even to the named party.
keywords: N + にしたところで; plain clause + としたところで
Even an expert cannot predict the future with certainty.
Even if we leave now, we will not make it.
I did not know the circumstances either.
formation: N + にしたところで; plain clause + としたところで
restrictions: Often followed by a negative or limited expectation.
mistake: It does not guarantee that the hypothetical condition is true.
